dateAssessment: Working dates use YAML’s July 2–3, 1748 span. July 2 is independently spoken (t03, t11); the year is inherited. All narrated daytime scenes are July 2. The closing dusk-to-dawn range is conditional: the table awards a long rest and sets the next session at 3 a.m., but does not play the awakening. The time extraction therefore remains compatible, with both bedtime and next-day handoff boundary conventions retained. Approximate afternoon clocks are shown as stated rather than rescaled to force elapsed-time arithmetic.

watches.summary: DM clocks place the den and Kenzo’s temple arrival in afternoon; rest, rituals and excavation pass between those rough anchors.
July 2 dinner is described as tonight, before retirement for the intended 3 a.m. resumption.
Awarded eight-hour rest plus planned 3 a.m. handoff implies dusk-to-dawn; Delwath’s requirement is four hours.
